title: How can find safe people to copy trading of them
author: roughytheone

comments.author: AoideusWasBanned
comments.body:
Since you two already trade for 3 years, you can probably judge a trader better than most people who copy. Main thing: never trust screenshots or a PDF statement. Only a track record that is verified and connected to the real broker account, ideally 1-2 years or more.

  
Then look at the max drawdown and the losing months, not the return. Smooth equity curves with a very high win rate are often grid or martingale, which looks great right until one bad move wipes the account. Also check that their account size is close to yours, or the copy won't match.

  
And start with a small part of the extra money for a few months before you add more.

replies.author: Unique_Horse12
replies.body: Solid advice especially on the equity curve part. A lot of the “signal providers” out there show 90%+ win rates and then blow up on one trade. If the curve looks too smooth, it probably is

replies.author: roughytheone
replies.body: Exactly bro. Thanks for your time. That is the problem I don't know where can I find this people. Is there any app or community for traders that allows the others to copy trade?

replies.author: AoideusWasBanned
replies.body:
A lot of brokers have a copy trading section built in now, so I'd start there instead of Telegram or Discord groups. At least the stats come from real accounts. Idk which one is good where you live though, so check what your own broker offers first.

Whatever you use, filter by time first (1 year+), then by drawdown. Most of the top of those leaderboards is people who got lucky last month.

replies.author: roughytheone
replies.body: Unfortunately we live in IRAN and we can't access to secure broker if any valid broker sees our IP we are banned forever even with a good vpn

replies.author: AoideusWasBanned
replies.body:
Ah, that's rough, sorry man. Then I'd be extra careful with copy trading offers in Telegram or Instagram groups, because that's exactly where scammers look for people who can't use normal brokers.

If you can, paper trade the same ideas yourself for a while first. It costs nothing and you learn way more than from copying someone.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: a statement is the easiest thing in this game to fake. ask for the investor password to the live account, the look-only login MT4 and MT5 accounts come with, and watch it for a month before any money moves. then check how big the positions get after a loss. a lot of the pretty gold curves come from adding to losers, and that works every time except the last.
